issue.title: lite/micro: Fix bug in tensor lifetime calculation.

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

issue.body:
Fix for issue #35121

The tensor lifetime may be incorrectly calculated in MicroAllocator::FinishTensorAllocation() if the same sensor is used multiple times as inputs to different operations or is used as input/output or variable of the graph.

issue.title: lite/micro: Add tensor allocation tests for #35121

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

issue.body:
Add a second operation to the MockModel sharing inputs with the first
operation to catch #35121 (Tensor lifetime incorrectly calculated on
multiple use) and verify the fix.

Both micro_allocator_test and micro_interpreter_test will fail with this change until  #35123 is merged.
